metadata.title: Greenwood Homes — Award-Winning Custom Home Builder
metadata.description: Greenwood Homes is an award-winning custom home builder crafting exceptional ground-up homes and remodels across Lake Tahoe, Nevada, California, Hawaii, Idaho, and Utah since 1998.

sections.purpose: Provide navigation to the site's core pages so visitors can reach portfolio, team, testimonials, and contact.
Introduce Greenwood Homes as an award-winning custom builder and immediately direct visitors to start a conversation.
proof: Award-winning custom home builder founded on quality craftsmanship, service, and honest client relationships
President and CEO Kevin Hanna
Since 1998 across Lake Tahoe, Nevada, California, Hawaii, Idaho, and Utah

sections.purpose: Present the company's scale and reliability with concrete numbers and geographic reach.
proof: Over 50 custom homes completed since 1998
Full construction divisions in five states
Offices in Incline Village, Nevada; Coeur d'Alene, Idaho; and Kauai, Hawaii
Licensed general contractor in California, Nevada, Hawaii, Idaho, and Utah

sections.purpose: Explain the full range of offerings from ground-up building to remodels and pre-construction planning.
proof: Custom home building from inception or after plans
Remodel and renovation including additions and energy-efficient upgrades
Pre-construction budget and timeline planning
Construction management and post-construction support
Sustainability with green building and LEED Accredited Professionals
